audit.why: Maokai owning 1-3, the lane levelling at 4-6 and Maokai reclaiming it at two items matches 47.21% Emerald+ over 159 games and both on-disk charts. Charts untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes gave Akali 'levels 2-3 (full pattern)' and left Maokai's level 6 unnamed and untimed.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is not available before level 3, and Maokai's level-6 spike is Nature's Grasp on 130/110/90s from 3000 range - a number you can actually play around.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes and phases[4].why rebuilt on level 3 and Nature's Grasp's 130s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were absent: Twisted Advance makes Maokai untargetable for the whole dash, and Sap Magic's cooldown is reduced every time he casts a spell OR is struck by an enemy spell.
audit.why: The untargetability means anything you throw at him mid-Twisted-Advance simply whiffs, so 'trade when it's down' needed to be 'nothing lands while it's travelling'. The Sap Magic clause is the one that changes how you play the lane: poking him with spells is what accelerates his heal, so chip damage is self-defeating and burst is not. Neither appeared anywhere.
audit.corrected: tldr, report[0].t, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, phases[0].why and content whys[2] now carry the untargetable dash and the Sap Magic acceleration.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns said only 'His lock-on root. Shroud-dodge it.' with no numbers.
audit.why: Twisted Advance is 14/13/12/11/10s, Bramble Smash 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s and Nature's Grasp 130/110/90s. Those three numbers are the whole timing game.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d now state them.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2].t and report[11].t both told you not to 'eat his R knockback'.
audit.why: Nature's Grasp is an advancing wall of brambles that damages and roots - there is no knockback on it. Bramble Smash is the knockback.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].t and report[11].t now say the root wall.
